series.name: Residential indoor timer/fault LED blink-count map
series.notes: Residential indoor timer/fault LED blink counts (Scribd copy of Hitachi service-manual chapter 6.0 Error Codes). Blink-count scheme (1-9 blinks) — separate from alphanumeric codes. Medium-high (service-manual chapter copy).

title.ur: Indoor unit start hi nahi hota

meaning.en: The indoor timer/fault LED does not blink at all and the unit never starts — the self-diagnosis LED is simply dead, so the fault is upstream of any code display.
meaning.ur: Indoor ka timer/fault LED bilkul blink nahi karta aur unit kabhi start nahi hota — self-diagnosis LED hi dead hai, yaani koi code dikhane se pehle hi masla hai

causes.en: Mains cord not connected properly at the PCB side or at the input AC plug side.
causes.ur: Mains cord PCB ki taraf ya input AC plug ki taraf theek se connected nahi

causes.en: Supply voltage at the PCB outside the 195V–265V window, a blown fuse, or a cut/damaged display harness.
causes.ur: PCB par supply voltage 195V se 265V ke range se bahar, fuse urja hua, ya display harness kata ya kharab

solutions.en: With power OFF, check mains-cord continuity end to end and reseat the plug and PCB connectors.
solutions.ur: Power OFF kar ke mains cord ki continuity aakhir tak check karein aur plug aur PCB ke connectors dobara baithayein

solutions.en: Measure supply at the PCB (expect 195V–265V), replace the fuse if open, and fit a stabiliser if the local supply is low.
solutions.ur: PCB par supply napen (195V se 265V hona chahiye), fuse khuli ho to badal dein, aur local supply kam ho to stabiliser lagayein

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

notes.en: Scribd copy of a Hitachi service-manual chapter; exact model scope not stated in the document. Confidence medium for that reason.
notes.ur: Yeh Hitachi service-manual chapter ka Scribd copy hai; document mein exact model scope nahi bataya gaya. Isi wajah se confidence medium hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: no blinking at all

meaning.en: The indoor LED blinks once per cycle: on heat-pump machines the refrigeration circuit is flagged (coil-temperature sensing / 4-way valve side).
meaning.ur: Indoor LED aik baar blink karta hai: heat-pump machines par refrigeration circuit ko flag kiya gaya hai (coil temperature sensing ya 4-way valve ki taraf)

causes.en: Coil temperature sensor position or fitment incorrect, or the sensor reading open/short.
causes.ur: Coil temperature sensor ki position ya fitment ghalat, ya sensor ki reading open/short hai

causes.en: 4-way reversing valve coil not switching or its wiring faulty; indoor PCB misreading the sensor.
causes.ur: 4-way reversing valve ka coil switch nahi ho raha ya us ki wiring kharab; indoor PCB sensor ki reading ghalat parh raha hai

solutions.en: Refit the coil temperature sensor in the correct position and confirm its connector is seated.
solutions.ur: Coil temperature sensor ko sahi position par dobara lagayein aur us ka connector baitha hua hai, is ki tasdeiq karein

solutions.en: Check the 4-way valve coil and its drive; if the LED still blinks once, replace the indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: 4-way valve ka coil aur us ka drive check karein; LED phir bhi aik baar blink kare to indoor PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

notes.en: Source marks this as heat-pump-only. Do not apply to cool-only machines.
notes.ur: Source ise heat-pump-only batata hai. Cool-only machines par ise lagu na karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 1 blink, pause, repeat

meaning.en: Two blinks mean the unit is in force-cooling / service-test mode, which is triggered by the temporary push button on the display board — it is a mode, not a refrigerant fault.
meaning.ur: Do blinks ka matlab hai unit force cooling ya service test mode mein hai, jo display board ke temporary push button se chalta hai — yeh aik mode hai, refrigerant kharabi nahi

causes.en: Temporary switch on the display sticker being pressed continuously because the front cover is fitted incorrectly.
causes.ur: Front cover ghalat lagne ki wajah se display sticker ka temporary switch baar baar daba hua hai

causes.en: Display-board push button stuck or its continuity permanent (button or display PCB defective).
causes.ur: Display board ka button atka hua hai ya us ki continuity permanent hai (button ya display PCB kharab)

solutions.en: Remove the front cover and refit it properly so the temporary switch releases.
solutions.ur: Front cover nikaal kar theek se dobara lagayein taake temporary switch azaad ho jaye

solutions.en: Power OFF, open the display PCB and check the push-button continuity with a multimeter without pressing it; replace the display PCB if it reads closed.
solutions.ur: Power OFF karke display kholein aur button ko dabae baghair multimeter se continuity check karein; band parhe to display PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

notes.en: is_fault false because force cooling is an intentional service mode; customers often report it as a fault.
notes.ur: is_fault ki value off rakhi gayi hai kyunke force cooling aik jaan boojh kar service mode hai; customers ise aksar kharabi ki tarah report karte hain

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 2 blinks, pause, repeat

title.ur: Dono units ke darmiyan communication kharabi

meaning.en: Three blinks mean the indoor and outdoor units are not exchanging signals correctly.
meaning.ur: Teen blinks ka matlab hai ke dono unit sahi tarah signal exchange nahi kar rahe

causes.en: Loose or wrongly landed A/B/C conductors at the indoor or outdoor terminal box.
causes.ur: Kamre ya bahar wali unit ke terminal box mein A/B/C conductors dheele ya ghalat lage huay hain

causes.en: Open/short or damaged inter-unit cable, or a defective indoor PCB communication circuit.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan cable kata ya short, ya kharab, ya indoor PCB ki communication circuit kharab

solutions.en: Re-check and re-tighten the A, B, C terminal connections at both ends against the wiring diagram.
solutions.ur: Wiring diagram ke mutabiq dono saron par A, B, C terminal connections dobara check kar ke kassain

solutions.en: Test/replace the inter-unit cable; if wiring is good, replace the indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Yon ke darmiyan cable test karke badlein; wiring theek ho to indoor PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

notes.en: Corroborated in practice by live Urdu/Hindi technician videos on 3-time blinking (e.g. youtube.com/watch?v=LQE_UL0AkvE, rFdhjUYAu18) — those videos give procedure only, no separate table.
notes.ur: Isay live Urdu/Hindi technician videos ne 3-time blinking par amali tor par confirm kiya hai (youtube.com/watch?v=LQE_UL0AkvE, rFdhjUYAu18) — un videos mein sirf procedure hai, alag table nahi.

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 3 blinks, pause, repeat

meaning.en: Four blinks mean the fault is on the outdoor unit; the indoor LED is only pointing you to the outdoor board, which stores the actual sub-code.
meaning.ur: Chaar blinks ka matlab kharabi outdoor unit par hai; indoor LED sirf us ke board ki taraf ishara karta hai jahan asli code save hota hai

causes.en: Any outdoor-unit protection trip (high pressure, discharge temperature, inverter or fan fault) reported through the indoor LED.
causes.ur: Bahar wali unit ka koi bhi protection trip (high pressure, discharge temperature, inverter ya fan kharabi) jo kamre wale LED ke zariye dikhaya gaya hai

causes.en: Indoor PCB interpreting the outdoor status incorrectly (cable/PCB fault giving a false 4-blink).
causes.ur: Kamre wala PCB bahar wali unit ki status ko ghalat samajh raha hai (cable/PCB kharabi se 4 blink ghalat aa raha hai)

solutions.en: Go to the outdoor unit, open the service panel and read the LED/alarm code displayed there.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ke paas ja kar service panel kholein aur wahan ka LED/alarm code parhein

solutions.en: Diagnose using the outdoor board's own code table for the installed model, then clear the alarm after repair.
solutions.ur: Lgaye gaye model ke outdoor board ki apni code table se diagnosis karein, phir theek karne ke baad alarm clear karein

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

notes.en: Pointer code only — the underlying fault must be read at the outdoor unit.
notes.ur: Sirf pointer code hai — asal fault outdoor unit par read hona chahiye.

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 4 blinks, pause, repeat

title.ur: Power relay ke contacts chipak jane ki kharabi

meaning.en: Five blinks indicate the power relay on the control board has welded contacts, so the board cannot disconnect the load it is supposed to control.
meaning.ur: 5 blinks ka matlab control board ke power relay ke contacts weld ho chuke hain, is liye board us load ko disconnect nahi kar pata

causes.en: Relay contacts welded after an overcurrent, inrush or a low-quality/aged relay.
causes.ur: Overcurrent, inrush ya kam quality wale purane relay ki wajah se relay ke contacts chipak gaye

causes.en: Compressor output/neutral circuit fault keeping the load permanently energised.
causes.ur: Compressor output/neutral circuit ki kharabi, jis ki wajah se load hamesha energised rehta hai

solutions.en: Verify the compressor output neutral and the relay driver; replace the indoor/relay PCB (relay is not serviced separately).
solutions.ur: Compressor output neutral aur relay driver check karein aur indoor/relay PCB badal dein (relay alag se nahi badalta)

solutions.en: After PCB replacement, confirm the load switches off with the command and check the supply for repeated surges.
solutions.ur: PCB badalne ke baad yaqeen kar lein ke command par load band hota hai aur supply mein bar bar surge na hon

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

notes.en: Safety-relevant: a welded relay can leave the compressor energised — do not leave the unit energised while waiting for parts.
notes.ur: Safety ke liye ahem: welded relay compressor ko energised chhor sakta hai — parts ka intezaar karte waqt unit ko energised na chhor dein.

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 5 blinks, pause, repeat

meaning.en: Nine blinks mean one of the room/pipe sensors is out of range (open or short) or its connector is not seated.
meaning.ur: 9 blinks ka matlab hai ke room/pipe me se koi sensor range se bahar (open ya short) hai, ya us ka connector theek se nahi laga

causes.en: Room or heat-exchanger thermistor open-circuit or short-circuit.
causes.ur: Room ya heat exchanger ka thermistor open-circuit ya short-circuit hai

causes.en: Loose/damaged sensor connector or harness, or a failed input channel on the indoor PCB.
causes.ur: Sensor ka connector ya harness dheela ya kharab, ya indoor PCB ka input channel kharab

solutions.en: Measure each sensor's resistance at room temperature and compare with the service-manual curve; refit loose connectors.
solutions.ur: Har sensor ki resistance room temperature par napen aur service manual ki curve se compare karein; dheele connectors dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Replace any sensor that reads open/short; if all sensors are good, replace the indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Open/short dikhane wala koi bhi sensor badal dein; sab sensors theek hon to indoor PCB badal dein

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

notes.en: The published residential blink list contains only no-blink/1/2/3/4/5/9 — other counts are not defined by this chapter.
notes.ur: Publish hui residential blink list mein sirf no-blink/1/2/3/4/5/9 hai — doosre counts is chapter se define nahi kiye gaye.

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 9 blinks, pause, repeat
